The Chinese characters for Deborah

As a transliteration, Deborah is usually written 德博拉 (Dé bó lā). Each character is listed below with its own dictionary meaning — the name is chosen by sound, not by meaning, and Moying does not translate names. Please have a person review the characters before any permanent use such as a tattoo.

Origin and meaning

The name Deborah has Hebrew roots and means “bee”.

About the name Deborah

In the Bible, Deborah was a prophetess and judge of Israel.
